card.fact_statement: Shigeru Ishiba was the incumbent LDP president prior to the 2025 Liberal Democratic Party presidential election.
card.source_span: The election was triggered by the resignation of Prime Minister of Japan and LDP president Shigeru Ishiba

target_qa_variants.question: Qui était le président sortant du PLD avant l'élection présidentielle du Parti libéral-démocrate de 2025 ?
target_qa_variants.source_span: The election was triggered by the resignation of Prime Minister of Japan and LDP president Shigeru Ishiba
target_qa_variants.translation_note: LDP is translated to its standard French acronym PLD (Parti libéral-démocrate). 'Incumbent' is translated as 'sortant' in the context of an election.

backtranslation_en.question: Who was the outgoing president of the LDP before the 2025 Liberal Democratic Party presidential election?

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The French translation accurately preserves the entity, relation, and expected answer of the source question without adding any new constraints.
